audit.why: This is the exact side/win[N] two-layer disagreement the chart rule guards against — a reader would see 'Skill' on the chart bar next to prose that flatly says the enemy wins every stage.
audit.corrected: Moved full phases[0..6].side to 'Milio' to match the already-correct content win[N] (no win[N] edit needed, per the chart rule, since win[N] already holds the target value), and rewrote each .why to state why Milio wins that stage, grounded in his kit (Fire Kick poke/no gap-closer, Warm Hugs knockback denying E, Cozy Campfire sustain, R cleanse+tenacity, item-scaling sustain).

audit.why: Spikes at Lvl2 (Warm Hugs denies E), Lvl6 (Solar Flare beats R's non-stun cleanse), 1st item (sustain item spike), Late (ult+heal outvalue lockup) are all grounded, specific, and already carry real ability names.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns has no digit (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT), and dosFull[1].d / dontsFull[2].d are copy-paste bleeds from tradeGood/tradeBad that ignore the actual E-charge and R-cleanse mechanics.

audit.corrected: Rewrote breakdown.cooldowns with real numbers (Breath of Life 160/145/130s, Warm Hugs 0.5s/2 charges, Cozy Campfire 29-21s), dosFull[1].d to call out the two E charges, and dontsFull[2].d to state the cleanse-not-stun distinction.
